rationale.reason: Complete non-powered freight wagons fit 8606; passenger coaches and rail maintenance vehicles are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This candidate PCR governs manufacture of a new complete non-self-propelled steel high-sided open railway freight wagon with integral flat floor, fixed end walls, high side walls and side doors, with declared unpowered bogies, brakes and couplings. The Eanoss manufacturer original establishes this substantive body boundary. It is narrower than CPC49533 and does not cover that entire classification leaf. Exclude boxcars, flatcars, hopper wagons and discharge-gate designs, tank/refrigerated wagons, other body architectures, locomotives, passenger vehicles, bare bodies/bogies, rebuilding, repair and freight transport services.

Foreground starts at actual received specified stock and completed supplier modules and ends at accepted configured empty wagon at the declared plant gate. Manufacturing acceptance belongs here only for attributable actual tests; operational loading/unloading/haulage, cargo yield, track infrastructure and life-cycle service are outside. No empirical mass, recipe, process intensity or life is prescribed. Scientific review remains pending. Sources: `tatra-model`, `tatra-factory`, `greenbrier-2022`.
reviewed_boundary.covered: New complete steel high-sided open freight wagon, integral flat floor/fixed ends/side doors and unpowered bogies
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Other freight body architectures, powered/passenger vehicles, independent components, reconstruction and service
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Complete configured empty accepted wagon with retained lubricant, without cargo, test loads, loose spares or protection

semantic_boundary.decision: New complete non-self-propelled steel high-sided open railway freight wagon with integral flat floor, fixed end walls, high side walls, side doors and declared bogie/brake/coupling configuration, evidenced by the Tatravagonka Eanoss manufacturer original. Exclude box/flat/hopper/tank/refrigerated wagons, locomotives, passenger vehicles, bare components and rebuilding/transport services. Narrower than CPC49533; no claim to cover the entire leaf. Existing track-material PCR excludes rolling-stock parts and no same complete open-wagon material record was found.

evidence_limitations: No actual accepted net mass M, manufacturing quantities, current supplier formulations, calibrated test or emission records were obtained. These acquisition requirements remain mandatory for a completed quantitative dataset.
2022 company-report evidence supports historical manufacturing-stage examples only; no empirical intensity/range or universal recipe adopted.
Body scope deliberately excludes box/flat/hopper/tank/refrigerated wagons and does not cover entire CPC49533.
